scope: Complete retained electronic authored work The Psalms in three source volumes: I (Psalms I-XXXVIII), II (XXXIX-LXXXIX), III (XC-CL). Each entire original XML source and its front/body/back, notes, printed/generated indexes, metadata, prolog, source URLs and reference context is included once in primary source-volume order. Distinct source publication statements remain per volume; no claim of one printed edition. Source-grouped Psalm headings remain literal. Colossians and Philemon is excluded as a separate complete work. Legacy volume masters, acceptances and identities remain unchanged as lineage. Human acceptance, print collation, rights clearance, CSS/pixel equivalence and publication remain separate.
